# pipeflow

Build fast interactive data analysis pipelines that scale.

{pipeflow} simply lets you add R functions one by one, wiring them into
a pipeline that stays consistent as you go. Modify, remove, or insert
steps at any stage, and manage all parameters in one place.

Thanks to its intuitive interface, {pipeflow} pays off quickly and, in
the long run, helps you keep a clear and structured overview of your
project.

![cartoon](reference/figures/cartoon.png)

### Why use {pipeflow}

- Lightweight and intuitive API
- All parameters managed in one place
- Pipeline verified at definition time
- Filter pipeline steps via views (supports data.table-style `[` filters
  ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/-new-orange))
- Branch and merge pipeline steps
- Fast dependency resolution (C++-powered DAG)
- Embed reusable workflows (nested pipelines)
  ![](https://img.shields.io/badge/-new-orange)

### Installation

``` r

# Install release version from CRAN
install.packages("pipeflow")

# Install development version from GitHub
devtools::install_github("rpahl/pipeflow")
```

### Usage

``` r

library(pipeflow)

p <- pip_new("demo") |>
    pip_add("numbers", \(n = 5) seq_len(n)) |>
    pip_add("squared", \(x = ~numbers) x^2) |>
    pip_add("total", \(x = ~squared) sum(x))

p
# <pipeflow> demo (3 steps)
# -------------------------
#       step params depends state
# 1: numbers      n           new
# 2: squared      x numbers   new
# 3:   total      x squared   new
# -------------------------
# <ready> last run: never

pip_run(p)
# info [2026-10-12 13:47:16.268 UTC]: Starting run of pipeflow 'demo'
# info [2026-10-12 13:47:16.269 UTC]: Step 1/3 numbers
# info [2026-10-12 13:47:16.276 UTC]: Step 2/3 squared
# info [2026-10-12 13:47:16.285 UTC]: Step 3/3 total
# info [2026-10-12 13:47:16.287 UTC]: Finished run of pipeflow 'demo'

pip_collect(p)
# $numbers
# [1] 1 2 3 4 5
# 
# $squared
# [1]  1  4  9 16 25
# 
# $total
# [1] 55
```

# Package index

## Getting started

Create a pipeline, add steps, and collect results.

- [`pipeflow`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-package.md)
  [`pipeflow-package`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-package.md)
  : pipeflow: Fast Interactive Data Analysis Pipelines
- [`pip_new()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_new.md) :
  Create a pipeline
- [`pip_add()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_add.md) :
  Add a step
- [`pip_collect()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_collect.md)
  [`pip_collect_out()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_collect.md)
  : Collect step outputs

## Modify steps

Replace, rename, remove, reset, or re-configure steps.

- [`pip_replace()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_replace.md)
  : Replace a step
- [`pip_rename()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_rename.md)
  : Rename a step
- [`pip_remove()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_remove.md)
  : Remove a step
- [`pip_reset()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_reset.md)
  : Reset a pipeline to its initial state
- [`pip_get_params()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_set_params.md)
  [`pip_set_params()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_set_params.md)
  : Get or set unbound parameters

## Pipeline composition

Combine or clone pipelines.

- [`rbind(`*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/rbind.pipeflow.md)
  : Bind pipelines
- [`pip_clone()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_clone.md)
  : Clone a pipeline

## Running pipelines

Execute pipeline steps or views.

- [`pip_run()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_run.md) :
  Run a pipeline
- [`pip_run_state()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_run_state.md)
  : Get the run state of a pipeline
- [`pip_param_value()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_param_value.md)
  : Unwrap a parameter value before a step function is called
- [`pipeflow_lgr()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow_lgr.md)
  : Default logger of pipeflow

## Locking and tagging

Lock steps against changes or tag them for filtering.

- [`pip_lock()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_lock.md)
  [`pip_unlock()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_lock.md)
  : Lock or unlock steps
- [`pip_tag()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_tag.md)
  [`pip_untag()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_tag.md)
  : Add or remove tags

## Inspection and views

Inspect the pipeline structure, access the step table, and create
filtered views.

- [`pip_view()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_view.md)
  : Create a pipeline view
- [`pip_data()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_data.md)
  : Access the underlying step table
- [`pip_graph()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_graph.md)
  [`pip_get_graph()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_graph.md)
  : Build pipeline graph data

## Extract and replace operators

Subset, read from and write to a pipeline using base R operators.

- [`` `[`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  [`` `[[`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  [`` `[[<-`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  [`` `[<-`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  [`` `$`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  [`` `$<-`( ``*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/Extract.pipeflow.md)
  : Extract or replace parts of a pipeline

## S3 methods

Generic methods for pipeflow objects.

- [`length(`*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/dim.pipeflow.md)
  [`dim(`*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/dim.pipeflow.md)
  : Dimensions of a pipeflow pipeline or view
- [`str(`*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/print.md)
  [`print(`*`<pipeflow>`*`)`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/print.md)
  : Print pipeflow objects

## Filtering helpers

Filter operators from data.table re-exported for use in view and subset
expressions.

- [`pipeflow-operators`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%like%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%ilike%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%flike%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%plike%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%chin%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%between%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%inrange%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  [`%notin%`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pipeflow-operators.md)
  : Row-filter operators re-exported from data.table

# Articles

### All vignettes

- [Get started with
  pipeflow](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v01-get-started.md):

  Start here if this is your first time using pipeflow.

- [Modify existing
  pipelines](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v02-modify-pipeline.md):

  How to insert, replace, and remove steps in a pipeline.

- [Combine
  pipelines](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v03a-combine-pipelines.md):

  How to combine different pipelines to a single pipeline.

- [Pipeline
  views](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v03b-pipeline-views.md):

  How to filter pipelines with
  [`pip_view()`](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/reference/pip_view.md)
  and the `[` operator, compose views, and run only a subset of steps.

- [Collect and group
  output](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v04-collect-output.md):

  How to collect and group pipeline output.

- [Split, map, and
  reduce](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v05a-split-map-reduce.md):

  Shows how to split data, apply the pipeline to each subset, and then
  reduce the results back into a combined output.

- [Nested
  pipelines](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v05b-nested-pipeline.md):

  Shows how to embed pipelines within pipeline steps and how to mark
  their parameters so that changing them re-executes the outer step.

- [Handling
  failures](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v05c-error-handling.md):

  Shows what happens when a step fails, how to keep a pipeline running
  with on_error = “continue”, how to react to failed inputs with ~try()
  references, and how to recover once the cause is fixed.

- [Annotated parameter
  values](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v05d-param-value.md):

  Shows how to store annotated values (e.g. values with units or labels)
  as step parameters and how to unwrap them right before a step function
  is called, using the pip_param_value() generic.

- [Self-modifying
  pipelines](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v06-self-modify-pipeline.md):

  Shows how you can setup pipelines to modify themselves at runtime,
  which, for example, allows for changing pipeline parameters based on
  intermediate results or even dynamically modify the pipeline’s own
  structure during a pipeline run.

- [pipeflow vs
  targets](https://rpahl.github.io/pipeflow/articles/v07-vs-targets.md):

  Comparing general properties and performance of {pipeflow} vs
  {targets} in a scoped latency comparison.
